title: Troubleshooting Gurgling Drains & Vent Blockages
description: When fixtures gurgle or drain slowly despite clear P-traps, blocked plumbing vent stacks are often the primary cause. Vents admit outdoor air into the drainage system, equalizing internal pressure so fluids flow smoothly. Without air intake, moving water creates a vacuum that pulls water out of P-traps, exposing living space to sewer gas. Common blockages include bird nests, leaves, ice buildup, or debris at the roof termination. Troubleshooting requires inspecting the roof vent line and clearing obstructions with a snake or water flush. Always verify vent terminations comply with local plumbing codes.

Without air intake, moving water creates a vacuum that pulls water out of P-traps, exposing living space to sewer gas. Common blockages include bird nests, leaves, ice buildup, or debris at the roof termination. Troubleshooting requires inspecting the roof vent line and clearing obstructions with a snake or water flush. Always verify vent terminations comply with local plumbing codes.
